questionEn: What fact on the topic “Chemical Element” is formulated without error?
questionUz: “Kimyoviy element” mavzusida qanday fakt xatosiz tuzilgan?
choicesEn: Type of atoms with the same nuclear charge (number of protons)
choicesUz: Yadro zaryadi bir xil bo'lgan atomlar turi (protonlar soni)
explanationEn: Element = atoms with the same Z (number of protons).
explanationUz: Element = bir xil Z bo'lgan atomlar (protonlar soni).
